dispute_ticket.description: I booked a 7.45am ride to the airport. By 7.56am the driver had not turned up so I cancelled and was charged S$4.00. He was clearly more than 10 minutes late. Please refund me.

chat_logs.content: Where are you? It's 10 minutes past already.
Trip cancelled by rider. Cancellation fee of $4.00 applied.

app_events.details: Rider R-8111 booked advance trip RYDE-PX-011 for 07:45. Driver D-7111 matched at 07:00.
Driver GPS sync error: no points received 07:20 to 07:56.
ETA unavailable: location signal lost. No further ETA was shown to the rider before cancellation.
Rider cancelled before driver arrival. No driver_arrived event.
$4.00 cancellation fee charged to rider payment method (credit card).

cancellation_fee_rider.text: The fee in SGD charged to a rider who cancels outside the free cancellation window. It governs rider cancellations only.

free_cancellation_within_min_of_match.text: Minutes after the driver is matched during which the rider may cancel without a fee. For an advance trip it governs only cancellations made soon after the match.

driver_late_free_cancel_min.text: Minutes by which the driver's latest ETA shown in the app before cancellation may exceed scheduled_time before the rider may cancel without any fee. It is measured from scheduled_time to that latest ETA arrival time, not from GPS data. If no ETA was shown, the rule cannot be applied.

expected_outcome.reason: The only rule on lateness (driver_late_free_cancel_min = 10) runs on the last ETA shown, but the 07:20:30 event says no ETA was available and the GPS is missing from 07:20 to 07:56 with no clean record to fill the gap. The driver's last message (07:30 'On the way') gives no time. It cannot be told whether the driver would have arrived within 10 minutes of 07:45, so a person must decide.
